title: Shah bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland

tellings.quote: that as amazing, the Shaw bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland in 1970.

plain: In 1970 the Shah of Iran bought laser isotope enrichment technology from Switzerland, a way of using lasers to concentrate the uranium needed for nuclear fuel or bombs. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells Michels this and calls it amazing, without naming a source. If true, it would mean Iran's nuclear ambitions reach back further than most people think.
